## Full text

### `logo-font-vectorization`

Logos are vectorized from Merriweather Black (wght 900) at the DEFAULT/text optical size — never the variable font's opsz max (144 = display), which looks 'not Merriweather'. The exact cut is Merriweather 2.002 (upem 1000), shipped by @fontsource/merriweather up to 5.2.x and vendored at scripts/fonts/merriweather-latin-900-normal.woff. Do NOT swap in @fontsource 5.3.0+: it ships Merriweather 2.100 (upem 2000) with different sidebearings, so letter spacing no longer matches the nxsflow wordmark. scripts/build-wordmarks generates every *-wordmark-* SVG (nxsflow, nexflow.it, manufakt.io, slidesend) plus the slidesend link preview (logos/slidesend/social/): plain advances, no kerning, 25/106 px per unit, 5px round-joined stroke in the ink colour, 26px padding, only the accent letter in the product accent — the f for the nxsflow family, both s for slidesend (per-entry in WORDMARKS); --check reports drift. It reproduces the original nxsflow wordmark to 0.01px. Favicon = monogram (nxsflow: n+f unmerged, logos/nexflow-parent/). scripts/render-logos also renders logos/<family>/social/*.svg at native size and, for a family with an adaptive favicon/<prefix>-favicon.svg, an opaque <prefix>-apple-touch-180.png (iOS fills transparency with black).

---

### `brand-skill-duplicate`

BRAND.md and plugin/skills/nxsflow-brand/SKILL.md are hand-maintained duplicates — there is NO generator for them (scripts/ holds render-logos and build-wordmarks, both for logo assets only). Any change to the '## Messaging' section must be applied to both and verified byte-identical, e.g.: awk '/^## Messaging$/,/^## Colors$/' <file> on each, then diff. The same check is worth running for '## Logo System' (up to '## Design Language'). The plugin copy is the one actually read, because it loads into every assistant session. Content changes also bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (minor for refinements, major for breaking) — that is the repo convention.

---

### `brand-repo-public-rules`

nxsflow/brand is a PUBLIC repo. Two standing rules: (1) Language rule from the GTM spec — no competitor name, no 'alternative to', no comparison to another vendor's product anywhere: not in BRAND.md, not in a copy deck, not in a commit message or PR. Write what holds, never why it changed. (2) The nexus-flow board (.nxs symlink) and .nxf/ must stay out of git; both are in .gitignore since 2026-08-08 — do not remove those entries.

---

### `logo-monogram-or-wordmark`

A surface shows a product's monogram OR its wordmark, never both: no combined lockup, and never the monogram beside the product name set as text. slidesend has an icon (stage frame with a phone in front) in the monogram's place, under the same either/or rule; its link preview shows the wordmark only. The monogram's colours are binding for the product's wordmark: same ink (#1C1C1C / #FAF9F7) and the accent letter in exactly the monogram's accent — nexflow.it f #B9FF66 on light AND dark (not #84CC16), manufakt.io f #DC2626, slidesend both s #7C3AED on light / #A78BFA on dark (= the icon's phone). Owner decisions 2026-09-23 (rnxt) and 2026-10-05 (q4mj).
